description: (Na)₂RbFeF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a RbFeF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the RbFeF₆ framework, Rb is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form RbF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Rb-F bond lengths are 2.57 Å. Fe is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent RbF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Fe-F bond lengths are 1.87 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Rb and one Fe atom.
